decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line builds directly on the firm's core design and fitting know-how, so its in-house R&D can interpret early results and refine the product.
This multi-model lever handle family is close to the established offer and fits the firm's broad system strategy, which favours continued assimilation and improvement.
A single handle design within the core domain is easy for the firm to evaluate and adapt, although single designs carry slightly more rotation risk.
This handle design sits squarely within the firm's existing knowledge base, so management can learn from early market feedback rather than withdraw it.
A lever handle family with several models leverages the firm's existing ergonomic and design expertise and widens system breadth.
This flagship electronic access system builds on the firm's access control competence and its strategic move toward digital building organisation, backed by its own R&D.
